shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular markers at boundaries of marked spans or plotted branches. Compare the marker at 2 on the number line in the left image with the marker at (−3, 0) in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The selected leftward ray includes 2. Right image: The plotted function excludes the left endpoint at x = −3.
Rationales: The selected left cue includes the indicated boundary point. The selected right cue excludes the indicated boundary point, so the two constraints differ in how they admit values.
